newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tsumura ordered to repay affiliate loan to Kofuku.
newsitem.headline: Tsumura ordered to repay affiliate loan to Kofuku.

text.p: Herbal medicine maker Tsumura and Co said on Monday that the Tokyo District Court had ordered it to pay 595 million yen and some interest to Kofuku Bank Ltd in a dispute over loans to a former Tsumura affiliate.
Tsumura said it may appeal to a higher court over the ruling.

"We cannot comment on the court order now as we have not fully studied it yet but we will consider future steps, including appealing to an upper court, after discussing the court order with lawyers," a Tsumura spokesman said.

Kofuku, a second-tier regional bank based in Osaka, had sought a court order demanding that Tsumura repay 850 million yen -- the remainder of Kofuku's loans to a former Tsumura subsidiary, Tsumura Shoji.
Tsumura has said that the loans to Tsumura Shoji were made without the approval of its board and therefore it is not liable.

Three other companies which also extended loans to Tsumura Shoji -- Toyo Trust and Banking Co Ltd, Yasuda Trust and Banking Co Ltd and Toho Mutual Life Insurance Co -- were separately seeking a similar court order, the Tsumura spokesman said.
